correctness.rationale: On the discrete cover base, local closure is the identity and subset refinement reverses ordinary inclusion. CM therefore gives arbitrary Boolean-lattice upsets per world. SL inclusion restricts covers to the empty set and the singleton world, while PLL identity removes the no-cover case. For finite CK-box, nonempty downward-directed cover families contain their total intersection, which becomes the least cover and yields the standard Kripke-box operator. The packaged exhaustive verifier confirms the local semantic quotients and canonical cores.

value.rationale: Modal cover semantics is introduced as a uniform enlargement of relational semantics across four intuitionistic modal systems. The discrete finite base isolates the modal layer from intuitionistic order effects and therefore gives a natural benchmark. The theorem exactly quantifies the semantic freedom left by each axiom package and shows that finite CK-box cover semantics adds no operator beyond ordinary Kripke relations, while CM retains the full Dedekind-sized monotone-neighborhood class.
